stable.label: Stablemaster
stable.unknown_horse: The stablemaster has no such horse.
stable.busy: Your purchase is still being written down. Wait a moment.
stable.too_poor: The {horse} costs {price} gold and you carry {gold}.
stable.bought: You bought a {horse} for {price} gold. Call it from your wheel (G) out in the open country.
stable.bought_instead: You bought a {horse} for {price} gold, in place of your {old}. Call it from your wheel (G) out in the open country.
stable.failed: The purchase could not be written down. You kept your gold.
stable.lost: The purchase could not be written down, and your gold could not be given back. Tell the staff.
stable.unreadable: The stablemaster cannot find the books right now. Try again in a moment.
stable.closed_far: You walked more than {metres} m away from the stablemaster.
stable.closed_not_in_world: You left the world, so the stable's window closed.
stable.call.no_horse: You have no horse. A stablemaster sells them.
stable.call.not_in_world: You have to be in the world to call your horse.
stable.call.not_outside: Your horse cannot reach you here. Call it out in the open country, outside the cities and buildings.
stable.call.not_settled: The game has not caught up with where you stand. Walk a few steps and call again.
stable.not_yours: This horse is not yours. Only its owner rides it.
